title: Cheap and not impressive
text:
Cheap and not impressive. The holder is cheap and flimsy. It's hard to get the brush or plunger out of the base, the door things stick a lot. The plumber especially sticks to the door and is difficult to pull out.

The brush works ok on the toilet. The plunger is odd-shaped and the rubber is extremely tough- I am not a weak person but it's hard for me to push the rubber plunger down to use it.

Don't like this set at all! Do NOT recommend.
